stages.prompt: Load config/presenter-voices.json if present, and the brand's config/brands/<brand>/POLICY.md. For each target locale write dubbing-plan.json: spoken beats, speaker count per beat, voice settings, brand pronunciation. Follow the brand policy for dialect and pronunciation. Do not call a provider.

PAID (HeyGen Precision Proofread). Show the plan and exact cost; ask for the first paid confirmation. Only then create per-beat proofread jobs with brand_glossary_id and save job records under the content.
Give the user the provider's reviewed target SRTs and check every brand-name occurrence. Wait for approval. Never replace provider text with Whisper output.
PAID. Ask for the second paid confirmation with exact cost, then render the approved beats. Preserve plan and job records.
Have the user listen to brand pronunciation, accent (Arabic Khaliji/Emirati) and lip-sync in each final. Wait for their decision.
